name: Algebraic Literal Summation
description: Replaces the boolean exposure condition (both literals evaluate to false) with an algebraic equivalent: the sum of $v \times (2s_{|v|} - 1)$ equals $-(|l_1| + |l_2|)$. This completely eliminates boolean logic terminology and explicit target requirements, forcing the model to deduce the 2-SAT equivalence from the algebraic extreme value.
